propositions.text: The claimant is 42 years old and a citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, availing herself of sections 96 and 97(1) of IRPA.
propositions.quote: XXXX XXXX XXXX, the claimant, who is 42 years old and a citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo ("DRC"), is availing herself of section 96 and subsection 97(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act (hereinafter referred to as the IRPA).

paragraphs.summary: The claimant is a 42-year-old DRC citizen applying under sections 96 and 97(1) of IRPA, as stated by the court.

propositions.text: Claimant alleges marriage to MLC member who campaigned for human rights and was sought by soldiers at her home in 2010
propositions.quote: the claimant alleges that she was married to XXXX XXXX XXXX, a member of the Mouvement de Libération du Congo (MLC) [movement for the liberation of the Congo]. He always campaigned for human rights and denounced human rights violations. Because of her husband's close relationship with XXXX XXXX, soldiers visited the claimant on XXXX XXXX XXXX 2010, looking for her husband.

paragraphs.summary: The claimant alleges marriage to an MLC member and soldiers visited her home in 2010 seeking her husband.

propositions.text: The claimant was unable to establish a serious possibility of persecution on the grounds alleged.
propositions.quote: The claimant was unable to establish a serious possibility of persecution on the grounds alleged.

paragraphs.summary: The court finds the claimant failed to establish a serious possibility of persecution on the alleged grounds.

propositions.text: The claimant did not discharge her burden of establishing a serious possibility of persecution on a Convention ground.
propositions.quote: the claimant did not discharge her burden of establishing a serious possibility that she would be persecuted on a Convention ground

propositions.text: The claimant did not establish on a balance of probabilities a personal risk of torture, risk to life, or cruel and unusual treatment if returned.
propositions.quote: on a balance of probabilities, she would be personally subjected to a danger of torture, a risk to her life, or a risk of cruel and unusual treatment or punishment should she return to her country

paragraphs.summary: The court finds the claimant failed to prove a serious possibility of persecution or personal risk of torture, death, or cruel treatment if returned.

propositions.text: The claimant is not a Convention refugee under section 96 of IRPA nor a person in need of protection under subsection 97(1) of IRPA.
propositions.quote: the panel determines that the refugee protection claimant is not a "Convention refugee" under section 96 of the IRPA or a "person in need of protection" under subsection 97(1) of the IRPA

paragraphs.summary: The court concludes the claimant is neither a Convention refugee nor a person in need of protection under IRPA.

propositions.text: The panel rejects the refugee protection claim filed by the claimant.
propositions.quote: The panel rejects the refugee protection claim filed by XXXX XXXX XXXX

paragraphs.summary: The court rejects the claimant's refugee protection claim.
